item.title: Updating Windows Network Profile Locations with PowerShell
item.description: So you’ve got a restrictive Windows Firewall, and you’re only allowing traffic to endpoints over either Domain or Private network locations, what happens if an end user doesn’t allow for network discovery and the device is left thinking it’s on a public network?
